items.source:
In line with Domain-Driven Design principles, this package includes implementations of
entities and value objects specific to the chat context, such as ChatPrompt and
ChatResponse, adhering to the ubiquitous language of chat interactions in AI models.
items.translation: 遵循领域驱动设计原则，本包包含了针对聊天上下文的实体和值对象实现，例如 ChatPrompt 和 ChatResponse，这些实现严格遵循人工智能模型中聊天交互的通用语言。

items.source:
This bounded context is designed to encapsulate all aspects of chat-based AI
functionalities, maintaining a clear boundary from other contexts within the AI domain.
items.translation: 该限界上下文旨在封装所有基于聊天的 AI 功能，确保其与 AI 领域内的其他上下文保持清晰的边界。

items.source: Implementation of Evaluator used to evaluate the factual accuracy of Large Language Model (LLM) responses against provided context.
items.translation: 实现Evaluator，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）响应与所提供上下文之间的事实准确性。

items.source: Evaluates the relevancy of a response to a query based on the context provided.
items.translation: 根据提供的上下文，评估响应与查询的相关性。

items.source:
The org.sf.ai.chat package represents the bounded context for the Chat Model within the
AI generative model domain. This package extends the core domain defined in
org.sf.ai.generative, providing implementations specific to chat-based generative AI
interactions.
items.translation: org.sf.ai.chat 包代表了生成式 AI 领域中聊天模型的限界上下文。该包扩展了 org.sf.ai.generative 中定义的核心领域，提供了针对基于聊天的生成式 AI 交互的具体实现。
